prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP TAYA adult woman weaving master, mature with silver-streaked brown hair in firm bun, ochre dress and deep plum work apron, holds one ordinary wooden shuttle herself, proud guarded posture. MIDDLE TINA clearly ADULT woman migrant dyer and apprentice, younger than Taya, dark braid, desaturated blue-grey short work tunic over brown skirt, rolled sleeves with small dark-indigo dye stains ONLY on cloth, small CLOSED personal belt pouch; hands empty, no bag handover. BOTTOM MEIBEI adult woman migrant night weaver and mother, chestnut hair beneath plain cream kerchief, dark moss dress, brown apron, holds a small plain mending spool; alert composed posture. Each woman is a distinct adult independent worker; no family insignia, completed apprenticeship, reconciliation, new signed trademark, known migration destination, or disclosure of former employer. TINA stays same original person across both quests, not a child.
